title: Apple Reference Image: A New Approach for Verified Photography
summary: Apple introduces Reference Image, a system for verifying the authenticity of photographs captured on iPhone. It uses cryptographic signing and secure hardware to attest that an image came directly from a camera sensor without manipulation, aiming to combat AI-generated and edited media. The Hacker News discussion (316 points, 225 comments) debates its technical design, privacy implications, and whether such provenance standards can gain broad adoption.
